title: chat.php briefing response
description: HTTP 200 body for action=brief. The fact table is always present and is rendered before any narration; narration.status is non-null when the model could not be used and explains why in physician-facing words. Built by PanelPayload::briefing().

prior_visit.description: Date of the prior visit the facts are relative to (YYYY-MM-DD), or null for a first visit on record.

sentences.description: Sentences that passed the Verifier, in model order.

omitted_fact_ids.description: Ids of must-surface facts the narration did not cite; the panel renders them under 'Also on file' straight from the fact table.

status.description: null on success. Otherwise a physician-facing reason the AI summary is unavailable.
enum: AI summary unavailable: provider busy, try again shortly
AI summary unavailable: not configured on this server

from_cache.description: True when the verified narration was served from copilot_briefing_cache; tokens are then zero.

total_failure.description: True when every sentence was stripped; the panel shows a distinct 'unable to verify' state and nothing is cached.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation id, also sent as the X-Correlation-Id header and used as the Langfuse trace id and audit-log key.

facts_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted fact ids, categories and values. Send it back with every ask.

facts.description: Every fact assembled for this chart, at most 50 per category plus a truncation fact.
